frameworks.name: OWASP LLM Top 10
frameworks.note: Published canonical list checked and source bytes hashed in references manifest.

frameworks.name: OWASP Agentic Top 10
frameworks.note: Official resource checked; immutable release artifact pin still required.

C-AUTH.name: Credential digests with tenant-bound route grants

C-PEER.name: Linux SO_PEERCRED peer binding before payload read

C-SENS.name: Trusted sensitivity classification, route clearance and durable agent taint

C-VAULT.name: Model-default scoped vault tokenization with explicit operator exceptions

C-RETR.name: Per-document retrieval authorization from Guard-owned records

C-GROUND.name: Citation provenance with optional strict source-extractive response contract

C-OUTCOME.name: Durable duplicate suppression with time-bound retention

C-AUDIT.name: Encrypted chained audit with archives and allowlisted export

C-EGRESS.name: Network-less Guard with independent allowlisting egress proxy

C-ADMIT.name: Component hash pin plus declared-capability static check

C-BUDGET.name: Shared workflow budgets with optional encrypted single-host recovery

C-LABEL.name: Workflow-wide sticky labels across artifacts and handoffs

C-PROVIDER.name: Text-only provider request allowlist (no provider-side URL fetch, hosted tools, storage or media)

C-DOMAIN.name: Backend identity for round-trip labels: canonical host names and declared data domains

C-AI.name: Configured action-bound AI assessment with deterministic precedence and actor-scoped context (synthetic wiring evidence)
C-AI.implementation: security_assessment.ChatSecurityAnalyzer, ai_security.AISecurityControl, security_context.SecurityHistoryStore, host internal inspection boundary

requirements.residual_risk: Detected patterns, configured field rules, declared context and Guard-observed data are controlled; undeclared unlabelled confidential prose that never passed through Guard is not recognized. requirements.name: Misinformation
control_names: Citation provenance with optional strict source-extractive response contract

scenarios.scope: grounding verifies citation provenance and quotes, not semantic entailment
authorized exact source text is released in extractive mode

requirements.residual_risk: Citation mode does not prove semantic support (confirmed gap). Optional extractive mode rejects added prose and enforces authorized verbatim spans in a strict format; source truth and misleading span selection/concatenation remain unverified.
